name: Jelis Aveniel
original_name: イーリス・アヴニール
source:
Star Sign: Aquarius
Hobby: Fortunes (They don't come true)
Special Skill: Calculation
Likes: Jewels, Bright Things
Dislikes: Poorness
Treasure: Gold, Life, Silver Flute

A traveling minstrel. He has a pretty appearance like a beautiful woman, but his nature is a greedy realist.
He earns his income by telling fortunes and playing songs.
Lately his biggest worry is that his body condition has gotten worse.
